Tool hint: when a compatibility check fails, run cortexdb compatibility --json and cortexdb validate before changing storage files. The diagnostic output points to API contract, SDK contract, and storage format mismatches.

source=docs_migration_matrix.md#sdk-v1-4
component=migration

Version conflict: SDK contract v1.4 requires API contract v1.4 or newer. If /v1/compatibility reports API contract v1.3 with SDK contract v1.4, the migration matrix marks the client as incompatible until the server is upgraded.
